ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description first: The attached circuit is a common-emitter BJT amplifier. The emitter is connected to the bottom ground node. The base is driven from the left through coupling capacitor C1 from a source with Rs, and RB connects the base node up to the +10 V rail. The collector is connected upward through RC to the +10 V rail. Capacitor C2 is connected from the collector/output node to the top of the load resistor RL on the right, and vo is marked across RL to ground. Reasoning: To find the lower cut-off frequency due to C2, set the independent input source to zero and treat the +10 V supply as AC ground. Since C1 = infinity, C1 is an AC short, so the base is AC-grounded through the source resistance/bias network. Remove C2 and find the resistance seen between its two terminals. On the collector side, ro = infinity and vπ = 0, so the dependent gm source is not excited by a collector-side test voltage; therefore the collector-side resistance to AC ground is RC. On the load side, the resistance to AC ground is RL. Hence the resistance seen by C2 is RC + RL. Using the values exactly as stated in the question, RC = 250 kΩ and RL = 1 kΩ would give Req = 251 kΩ and fL2 = 1/(2π Req C2) = 1/(2π × 251000 × 4.7 μF) ≈ 0.135 Hz. This conflicts with the provided standard answer. The standard answer 27.1 Hz is obtained if RC is taken as 250 Ω rather than 250 kΩ, likely indicating a unit typo in the parameter list. Under that intended assumption, Req = 250 + 1000 = 1250 Ω, so fL2 = 1/(2π × 1250 × 4.7 μF) ≈ 27.1 Hz.

method.method_draft: Describe the image first: C2 is the capacitor between the collector output node and the top of RL. For AC analysis, ground the +10 V supply and the input source, and treat C1 = infinity as a short. Remove C2 and look into its two terminals. The left terminal sees RC to AC ground because ro is infinite and the controlled source is not excited by the collector test voltage; the right terminal sees RL to ground. Therefore the resistance for C2 is RC + RL. Substitute C2 = 4.7 μF, RL = 1 kΩ, and the intended RC = 250 Ω: fL2 = 1/[2π(4.7 μF)(1250 Ω)] ≈ 27.1 Hz.

method.method_draft: After reading the image structure, replace the amplifier output seen at the collector by its Thevenin equivalent: a signal source with series output resistance RC, since the supply is AC ground and ro is infinite. The load side is RL to ground, connected through the series capacitor C2. Write the output divider relation V0/Vth = RL / [RC + RL + 1/(sC2)]. Put it into high-pass form: V0/Vth = sC2 RL / [1 + sC2(RC + RL)]. The cutoff is therefore fL2 = 1/[2π C2(RC + RL)]. Substituting C2 = 4.7 μF, RL = 1 kΩ, and the intended RC = 250 Ω gives approximately 27.1 Hz.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个共射极 BJT 放大器。输入源 vs 经过 Rs 和耦合电容 C1 接到基极，基极还有偏置电阻 RB 接到 +10V。集电极通过 RC 接到 +10V，发射极接地。输出端从集电极经串联耦合电容 C2 接到右侧负载 RL，输出电压 v0 标在 RL 两端。推理：求由 C2 造成的低频截止时，把集电极侧放大器输出等效为 Thevenin 信号源，因电源为交流地且 ro = ∞，其串联输出电阻为 RC。负载侧为 RL 接地，C2 串联在 RC 与 RL 之间。因此输出分压为 V0/Vth = RL / (RC + RL + 1/(sC2))，化为高通形式为 V0/Vth = s C2 RL / [1 + s C2 (RC + RL)]。所以由 C2 产生的下限截止频率为 fL2 = 1 / [2π C2 (RC + RL)]。按指定方法采用 C2 = 4.7 μF、RL = 1 kΩ、意图使用的 RC = 250 Ω，则 RC + RL = 1250 Ω，fL2 = 1 / [2π × 4.7×10^-6 × 1250] ≈ 27.1 Hz。

推理：求由 C_2 单独引起的低频截止时，C_1=∞ 可视为交流短路且不引入低频极点。把 C_2 左侧的放大器输出端等效为 Thevenin 信号源；由于 +10V 为交流地且 r_o=∞，在求输出等效电阻时从集电极看进去的电阻为 R_C。C_2 右侧是 R_L 对地，因此通过 C_2 形成的输出耦合网络为串联的 R_C、1/(sC_2) 和 R_L，输出取在 R_L 上：
V_0/V_th = R_L / [R_C + R_L + 1/(sC_2)] = sC_2 R_L / [1 + sC_2(R_C+R_L)]。
所以该高通环节的下限截止频率为
f_{L2}=1/[2π C_2(R_C+R_L)]。

若严格按题干文字参数 R_C=250 kΩ、R_L=1 kΩ、C_2=4.7 μF 代入，则 R_C+R_L=251 kΩ，得到 f_{L2}=1/[2π·4.7×10^{-6}·251×10^3]≈0.135 Hz。这个结果与给出的标准答案 27.1 Hz 不一致。

标准答案 27.1 Hz 对应的是将 R_C 取为 250 Ω，即 R_C+R_L=250 Ω+1000 Ω=1250 Ω，此时
f_{L2}=1/[2π·4.7×10^{-6}·1250]≈27.1 Hz。
因此，若按题干字面单位计算为 0.135 Hz；若按标准答案所隐含的更正值 R_C=250 Ω，则答案为 27.1 Hz。

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Model the transistor collector circuit as a Norton/Thevenin small-signal source with output resistance RC because ro = infinity. The output coupling network is then a first-order high-pass path consisting of source resistance RC, series capacitor C2, and load RL. The denominator is RC + RL + 1/(sC2), so the pole occurs at ωL = 1/[C2(RC + RL)] and fL = ωL/(2π).

solver_metadata.cot_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个共射极 BJT 放大器。输入源 vs 经过 Rs 和耦合电容 C1 接到基极，基极还有偏置电阻 RB 接到 +10V。集电极通过 RC 接到 +10V，发射极接地。输出端从集电极经串联耦合电容 C2 接到右侧负载 RL，输出电压 v0 标在 RL 两端。推理：求由 C2 造成的低频截止时，把集电极侧放大器输出等效为 Thevenin 信号源，因电源为交流地且 ro = ∞，其串联输出电阻为 RC。负载侧为 RL 接地，C2 串联在 RC 与 RL 之间。因此输出分压为 V0/Vth = RL / (RC + RL + 1/(sC2))，化为高通形式为 V0/Vth = s C2 RL / [1 + s C2 (RC + RL)]。所以由 C2 产生的下限截止频率为 fL2 = 1 / [2π C2 (RC + RL)]。按指定方法采用 C2 = 4.7 μF、RL = 1 kΩ、意图使用的 RC = 250 Ω，则 RC + RL = 1250 Ω，fL2 = 1 / [2π × 4.7×10^-6 × 1250] ≈ 27.1 Hz。
possible_risk_flags: 题干参数写作 R_C = 250 kΩ，但指定方法和标准答案使用意图值 R_C = 250 Ω；若直接使用 250 kΩ 会得到约 0.134 Hz。

raw_record.original_question: Question: Consider the common emitter amplifier shown in the figure with the following circuit parameters: \( \beta = 100 \), \( g_m = 0.3861\,A/V \), \( r_o = \infty \), \( r_a = 259\,\Omega \), \( R_s = 1k\Omega \), \( R_B = 93k\Omega \), \( R_C = 250k\Omega \), \( R_L = 1k\Omega \), \( C_1 = \infty \) and \( C_2 = 4.7\,\mu F \). The lower cut-off frequency due to \( C_2 \) is ________ Hz.
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description first: The attached circuit is a common-emitter BJT amplifier. The emitter is connected to the bottom ground node. The base is driven from the left through coupling capacitor C1 from a source with Rs, and RB connects the base node up to the +10 V rail. The collector is connected upward through RC to the +10 V rail. Capacitor C2 is connected from the collector/output node to the top of the load resistor RL on the right, and vo is marked across RL to ground.

Reasoning: To find the lower cut-off frequency due to C2, set the independent input source to zero and treat the +10 V supply as AC ground. Since C1 = infinity, C1 is an AC short, so the base is AC-grounded through the source resistance/bias network. Remove C2 and find the resistance seen between its two terminals. On the collector side, ro = infinity and vπ = 0, so the dependent gm source is not excited by a collector-side test voltage; therefore the collector-side resistance to AC ground is RC. On the load side, the resistance to AC ground is RL. Hence the resistance seen by C2 is RC + RL.

Using the values exactly as stated in the question, RC = 250 kΩ and RL = 1 kΩ would give Req = 251 kΩ and fL2 = 1/(2π Req C2) = 1/(2π × 251000 × 4.7 μF) ≈ 0.135 Hz. This conflicts with the provided standard answer. The standard answer 27.1 Hz is obtained if RC is taken as 250 Ω rather than 250 kΩ, likely indicating a unit typo in the parameter list. Under that intended assumption, Req = 250 + 1000 = 1250 Ω, so fL2 = 1/(2π × 1250 × 4.7 μF) ≈ 27.1 Hz.
